controls.title: S3 Bucket Server-Side Encryption
controls.risk: Without encryption at rest, anyone who gains unauthorized access to the underlying storage can read the raw data directly.
controls.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource for this bucket with sse_algorithm = "AES256".

cis_aws.note: S3 encryption at rest is not a recommendation in v5.0.0.

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control S3.17 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted; S3.17 is the KMS variant, so this is a related mapping

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: S3 Bucket Versioning
controls.risk: Without versioning, an accidental or malicious overwrite/delete permanently destroys the data — there is no way to recover a prior version.
controls.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource for this bucket with status = "Enabled".

cis_aws.note: S3 versioning is not a recommendation in v5.0.0 (2.1.2 there is MFA Delete).

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control S3.14 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: S3 Block Public Access
controls.risk: Disabling this safeguard means the bucket could be made publicly accessible, intentionally or by mistake, exposing its contents to the entire internet.
controls.remediation: Set block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets to true.

items.title: Ensure that S3 is configured with 'Block Public Access' enabled

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control S3.8 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: RDS Storage Encryption
controls.risk: Unencrypted database storage means raw data is readable if the underlying disk is ever accessed without authorization.
controls.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true on the RDS instance.

items.title: Ensure that encryption-at-rest is enabled for RDS instances

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control RDS.3 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: RDS Publicly Accessible
controls.risk: A database reachable directly from the internet is one of the most common real-world breach vectors — attackers actively scan for exposed databases.
controls.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false on the RDS instance, and access it via a bastion host or VPN instead.

items.title: Ensure that RDS instances are not publicly accessible

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control RDS.2 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: Admin Ports (SSH/RDP) Open to the Internet - IPv4
controls.risk: SSH (22) or RDP (3389) open to 0.0.0.0/0 means anyone on the internet can attempt to log in - a constant, automated attack target. Exposed remote desktop is also a very common ransomware entry point.
controls.remediation: Restrict the security group's ingress CIDR block for ports 22 and 3389 to a specific internal range, not 0.0.0.0/0.

items.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports

cis_aws.note: Covers the IPv4 range 0.0.0.0/0. The benchmark's administration ports include SSH (22) and RDP (3389).

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub EC2.13 (port 22) related requirements, base controls only; applied to RDP (3389) by analogy because the Security Hub page for EC2.14 lists no NIST mapping

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: Admin Ports (SSH/RDP) Open to the Internet - IPv6
controls.risk: SSH (22) or RDP (3389) open to ::/0 means anyone on the internet can attempt to log in - a constant, automated attack target. Exposed remote desktop is also a very common ransomware entry point.
controls.remediation: Restrict the security group's ingress CIDR block for ports 22 and 3389 to a specific internal range, not ::/0.

items.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports

cis_aws.note: Covers the IPv6 range ::/0. The benchmark's administration ports include SSH (22) and RDP (3389).

nist_800_53.basis: Same mapping as 5.3 (IPv6 variant of the same requirement)

controls.title: EBS Volume Encryption
controls.risk: An unencrypted disk volume exposes raw data if the volume is ever improperly detached, snapshotted, or accessed outside its intended instance.
controls.remediation: Set encrypted = true on the EBS volume.

items.title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled in all regions

cis_aws.note: CIS 5.1.1 is the account-level default-encryption setting; this control checks each volume.

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control EC2.3 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: IAM Wildcard Policy
controls.risk: A policy granting Action="*" and Resource="*" gives full administrative control over the entire AWS account to anything using it — a single compromised credential means total account takeover.
controls.remediation: Scope the policy's Action and Resource fields to only the specific permissions needed, instead of "*".

items.title: Ensure IAM policies that allow full '*:*' administrative privileges are not attached

cis_aws.note: CIS 1.15 checks policies that are attached; this control checks policy definitions in Terraform, so it catches the problem before anything is attached.

nist_800_53.basis: AWS Security Hub control IAM.1 (related requirements); base controls only, enhancements omitted

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)

controls.title: Hardcoded Credentials
controls.risk: A password committed directly in source code is visible to anyone with repo access, remains in Git history forever even if later removed, and is a leading cause of real-world credential leaks.
controls.remediation: Move the password into a Terraform variable marked sensitive = true, supplied via .tfvars (gitignored) or a secrets manager.

cis_aws.note: No CIS AWS recommendation covers secrets in Terraform source.

nist_800_53.basis: Author-assigned: AWS Security Hub has no equivalent control. IA-5(7) is 'No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators'

iso_27001.basis: Author-assigned by control intent; indicative only (no official crosswalk used)
